name: Cut & Paste
description: A stop-motion cut-paper collage: torn color blocks, a constructivist wedge, a halftone sun and cut-outs get slapped onto newsprint by hand, then the headline lands as ransom-note scraps with a pointing hand, a speech bubble and scribbles.
useWhen: Loud, crafty, retro moments: music and streetwear drops, event posters, a zine-style title card, an announcement that should feel handmade rather than slick. Pass your own photos in images to cut them in as paper scraps.

headline.label: Headline
headline.help: One to four short lines. *Starred* words are cut letter by letter.

kicker.label: Kicker
kicker.help: Taped above the headline. Leave empty for none.

bubble.label: Speech bubble
bubble.help: Leave empty to hide the bubble.

rate.label: Frame rate
rate.help: Drawings per second: lower feels more hand-animated.

jitter.label: Hand jitter
jitter.help: How much pieces shift between drawings.

images.label: Images
images.help: Up to 3 image URLs cut in as photo scraps (must allow cross-origin loading).

seed.label: Shuffle
seed.help: Another mix of fonts, scraps and tilts.
